ticket.title: Secure flight history CSV exports
ticket.description: Passengers can download a CSV for one of their completed flight histories. The export must remain restricted to the signed-in passenger who owns that history.
requirements: Require the caller to be signed in.
Export the requested flight history only when it belongs to the signed-in passenger.
Do not reveal another passenger's flight history.

pr.title: Scope flight history exports to the requesting passenger
pr.description: Updates the history lookup to require both the requested history ID and the signed-in passenger ID.
pr.author: nova-dev

aiReview.summary: Trace both the requested history ID and the signed-in passenger ID into the lookup. Does the export return data only when those two values identify the same record?

proposedAnswer.reason: The repository lookup scopes the requested history to the signed-in passenger, so changing a history ID cannot retrieve another passenger's export.
